catalogue.note: Built at Figma’s own 390 wide and own height: every size in the frame is a whole number, no scale to recover. Square and unframed: Figma’s 1px black outside stroke on the frame is left off, so the diff runs on the 390-wide region inside it (the export is 2px larger each way). Inter Regular and Bold, as Figma names them, from the Inter Variable 4.001 file on this Mac, embedded whole; the width probe shows Inter rendering. Every text box matches Figma’s position and size; flat colours are exact; what differs is glyph-edge antialiasing, plus the 11px text (13px line), which Chrome sets one pixel higher than Figma where the box sits on a whole pixel: an engine difference in baseline rounding, left uncorrected. “0×8f4a” is written with the multiplication sign Figma’s older Inter shows for the layer’s 0x8f4a.
